classification: development compatibility and backend pilot; not held-out performance evaluation

selection.reason_not_held_out: Both cases were inspected while extending target parsing and checking the current static signals. Their outcomes must not be used as an unbiased ranking benchmark.
selection.other_survey_copies: BigMod, Rarimo DateEncoder, UniRep EpochKeyLite and zk-email FpMul remain ignored local surveys; they are not selected targets or execution attempts.

environment.classification: current development comparison environment, not historical deployment

valid_execution_finding_requires: candidate hash and run/target link match the saved plan and outcome
the linked backend status is bug_found
candidate inputs satisfy the predeclared input contract
the complete assignment satisfies every constraint in the frozen original R1CS
the assignment violates the predeclared component property
review_rule.fixed_variant_scope: paired comparator for the named cause only

pairs.independence_class: witness-only output selection / omitted equivalence constraint
pairs.revision_relationship: The fixed revision is a direct child of the vulnerable revision, and its Decoder change adds the IsZero constraints. The public zkbugs README has no Fix Commit entry; this relationship was checked from the circomlib history.
pairs.input_preconditions: inp is a canonical BN128 field element; no narrower caller domain is assumed.
pairs.predeclared_property: For Decoder(4), each out[i] equals 1 exactly when inp equals i, otherwise 0, for i in 0..3; success equals the sum of those four outputs.
pairs.violation_rule: A complete satisfying assignment for the vulnerable frozen target meets the input precondition but breaks any of the four output equivalences or the success relation.
pairs.project_reachability: The published original entrypoint is the same as the direct wrapper; no larger project caller is established here.

pairs.revision_relationship: The vulnerable revision is an ancestor of the public Fix Commit. In BigLessThan, Num2Bits(254) is replaced by Num2Bits_strict; other source changes in the fix do not count as separate cases.
pairs.input_preconditions: Both inputs are canonical BN128 field elements interpreted as integers in [0,p-1]. A noncanonical internal Num2Bits decomposition remains a valid object of review.
pairs.predeclared_property: BigLessThan.out equals 1 exactly when the canonical integer representative of in[0] is less than that of in[1], otherwise 0.
pairs.violation_rule: A complete satisfying assignment for the vulnerable frozen target meets the input precondition but BigLessThan.out disagrees with the canonical integer comparison.
pairs.project_reachability: The published original entrypoint is packages/circuits/generated/bigComparators.circom; a broader production caller is not established here.
pairs.dependency_layout_adapter: The relative circomlib symlink in each variant recreates the source's ./circomlib include layout; reviewed source bytes are unchanged.
